name: print-social-halftone-folder-banner-retail-projects
title: Galaxy halftone banner with a 'retail projects' folder
whatItIs: A wide banner with a blue-purple galaxy image treated in coarse halftone dots. A manila folder labelled 'retail projects' sits at centre, with a cursor, a white scribble, and Photoshop, Figma, Illustrator and spark icons.
whatItMeans: Deep and cosmic yet nostalgic; halftone gives space imagery a print feel.
techniques: Convert a dramatic photo to halftone so it becomes texture.
Keep the folder in the same position across a series.
Use a white scribble burst for contrast against a dark background.
Include tool icons as skill hints.

vocabulary.definition: A photograph rendered as a dot pattern.
Reusing one composition with changed content.
A pixel arrow used as a decorative pointer.
